files.rationale: Both PRs added the same Streamdown wrapper and differ only in the wrapper class, so PR A's version (plain `streamdown-markdown` class) is kept because PR A owns the Streamdown integration and PR B only carries this file incidentally alongside its lockfile change.

PR B only reformatted the base scroll-to-bottom line into braces style, while PR A replaced it with the setTimeout plus scrollIntoView page-level auto-scroll fix, so PR A's implementation is kept and the rest of the merged file is unchanged.
